# PDF Dark Mode

> Dark mode for every PDF you read. Browser extension for Chrome and Edge + free web reader.

- Homepage: https://pdf-dark.com/
- Web reader (free, files stay on-device): https://pdf-dark.com/reader.html
- Help: https://pdf-dark.com/help.html
- About: https://pdf-dark.com/about.html
- Changelog: https://pdf-dark.com/changelog.html
- Privacy: https://pdf-dark.com/privacy.html
- Terms: https://pdf-dark.com/terms.html

## What it is

- Overlay dark mode for online PDFs and local file:// PDFs.
- Darkness + contrast sliders; Sepia and AMOLED modes (Pro).
- Per-site allow/block rules and saved overlay areas (Pro).
- Experimental full-dark pdf.js viewer (beta) for PDFs the overlay cannot reach.
- Pro is a one-time $9.99 payment via Lemon Squeezy. No subscription, no account.
